messages.subject: Overdue: Invoice INV-2291 — Kot Addu mobilisation
messages.body:
Dear Sir/Madam,

Invoice INV-2291 dated 09 February for PKR 4,180,000 covering mobilisation works at Kot Addu remains unpaid and is now 32 days past due. This was submitted to your operations desk on 09 February and acknowledged on 11 February.

We would be grateful for a payment date. Our site team has been instructed to hold further mobilisation pending settlement.

Regards,
Accounts Receivable
Delta Civil Works (Pvt) Ltd

messages.subject: Few things before Thursday
messages.body:
Morning team,

Three things, sorry to bundle them:

1. I need site access cleared for two of our engineers at Kot Addu on Thursday 19th — Rizwan has their CNIC details already, he sent them to the desk last week. They will be on site 08:00 to 17:00.

2. Can someone confirm whether Zenith Engineering's contractor all-risk insurance certificate was renewed? It expired at the end of February as far as I can see, and they are still working on the bund.

3. Delta Civil are calling me directly about an unpaid invoice from February. I have nothing to tell them. Can someone find out where that sits?

Thanks,
Junaid
Asset Manager — Thermal & Solar

From: Licensing Directorate <licensing@energyregulatory.gov.pk>
Subject: Request for information — Licence No. GEN-2019-0447, Kot Addu Solar

Dear Licensee,

Under Regulation 14(3), the Authority requires the following in respect of Licence No. GEN-2019-0447:

(a) certified generation data for the period July 2025 to December 2025;
(b) confirmation of the current technical services agreement and the identity of the O&M contractor;
(c) a statement of any unplanned outages exceeding 24 hours.

A response is required within ten (10) working days of the date of this notice, being 27 February 2026. Failure to respond within the stipulated period may result in enforcement proceedings under Section 28.

Licensing Directorate

messages.subject: RE: Site access — Kot Addu solar, week of 16 March
messages.body:
One more thing on this — nothing to do with the passes.

The bund around transformer T3 has been leaking since Tuesday. There is standing oil inside the bund and some seepage at the eastern joint onto the gravel. Zenith's men noticed it, not us. I have put sand down and taped it off.

Does this need to go to HSE formally or can we just get Zenith to patch it? I do not want to raise an incident if it turns out to be nothing, but I also do not want to be the one who sat on it.

Rizwan

messages.body:
Dear Customer,

Our records indicate that the authorised signatory mandate for account 0041-778-2 (Pentland Infrastructure Partners — Operations) was last updated in November 2023.

Please provide an updated list of authorised signatories together with specimen signatures and CNIC copies, certified by a director. Where a previously authorised signatory has left the organisation, please confirm the date of departure.

Until the mandate is refreshed, transactions above PKR 5,000,000 may be subject to additional verification.

messages.subject: Variation Order VO-14 — additional excavation, bund works
messages.body:
Dear Operations,

Further to site instruction SI-09, please find attached Variation Order VO-14 covering additional excavation and disposal at the transformer bund, valued at PKR 1,240,000.

We have held the plant on site since Monday awaiting written approval. Standing time is accruing at PKR 85,000 per day and will be claimed separately if approval is not received by Friday 13 March.

Please confirm approval in writing.

Adeel Butt
Contracts Manager, Zenith Engineering
